# CI coverage matrix

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/ci/coverage-matrix.mjs` from the workflows, `test:drift`, the guard catalog, `scripts/lib/requiredChecks.mjs` and `scripts/ci/coverage-matrix.json`. Do not edit by hand; `--check` in `npm run test:guards` fails a stale copy. -->

For each source folder and each Worker service with its own release gate: which
checks run, when, whether main's ruleset requires them, the highest level of
evidence any of them gives, and the open issue that owns the next level. It
states what exists on this commit (D8694).

A suite step runs inside `ci.yml` › `suite`, one of the parts of `npm run test:drift`;
those parts report through the required `test:drift (full suite)` context.

## Levels

| Level | What a pass shows |
| --- | --- |
| unit and contract | Code, contracts and guards on this commit, with fakes in place of every provider. |
| isolated browser | A real browser against a local build or Worker on fixtures, with no deployed service. |
| staging | A hosted, isolated environment with synthetic data, torn down after the run. |
| provider-backed pilot | A real provider call on synthetic input. |
| production monitoring | A read of, or a probe against, the live production system. |
